# scylladbcloud_cluster (Data Source)

One cluster, by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_cluster" "example" {
	cluster_id = 1337
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `client_encryption_mode` (String) Client-to-node encryption mode.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider, e.g. AWS.
- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter name.
- `dns` (Boolean) Whether DNS names are enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.
- `node_count` (Number) Number of ACTIVE nodes.
- `node_dns_names` (List of String) DNS names of the ACTIVE nodes.
- `node_private_ips` (List of String) Private IPs of the ACTIVE nodes.
- `region` (String) Cloud region, e.g. us-east-1.
- `replication_factor` (Number) Replication factor.
- `scylla_version` (String) Scylla version.
- `status` (String) Cluster status, e.g. ACTIVE.
- `user_api_interface` (String) CQL or ALTERNATOR.
